descriptionChirho: To flee or escape from danger or threat, moving away quickly in a definite direction (Qal and Pual stems).
To wander about without fixed direction or home, often as a fugitive or homeless person; used substantively as 'wanderer, fugitive' (Qal participle and infinitive).
To flutter or flap, describing the movement of wings or wing-like motion (Qal participle).
To shake or wag the head, typically as a gesture of scorn or pity (Hitpael reflexive stem).
To chase away or drive out someone, the causative sense of fleeing (Hifil stem).
To be chased away, driven out, or cast off as a passive recipient of expulsion (Hofal stem).
